name: Noir as Love
detailed_description:
🖤 Love is a battlefield and every choice is a card you play.

In Noir as Love, you journey through the highs and heartbreaks of a relationship - one encounter at a time. Navigate the Relationship Path, a series of emotional battles where each phase of love is brought to life through strategic, card-based combat. From nervous first dates to soul-crushing breakups, your deck is your identity, and every emotion is an enemy.

Build your personality. Fight your feelings. Survive the story - or start over.

💌 Relationship as Roguelike

Each run is a fresh take on a romance gone right or wrong. Encounter procedurally generated events themed around key relationship moments:

  • First Date - build synergy

  • Argument - manage conflict

  • Reconciliation - repair and recover

  • Breakup - survive the fallout

🧠 Emotionally-Driven Deckbuilding

Start with a modest deck reflecting your personality. Add and remove cards like Charm, Communication, Jealousy, or Deflection to shape your emotional strategy.

🕯️ Permanent Death, Permanent Growth

If your life runs out, the run ends. But each failed relationship leaves behind lessons:
Unlock new starting decks, discover powerful new cards, and develop long-term strategies with meta-progression systems.

🔄 Procedural Encounters

No two paths are the same. Enemy types, encounters, and emotional matchups are randomized each run — ensuring every love story is unique.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i3 / AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated (Intel HD 4000)
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i5 / AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated (GTX 960 / RX 570)
  • Storage: 7 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13+
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Integrated
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12+
  • Processor: Apple Silicon M1/M2 or Intel i5+
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: M1 GPU or Radeon 560X
  • Storage: 7 GB available space
